item.title: Bulletin updated at 16:30 HKT 22/Apr/2026
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A cold front will move across the coastal areas tomorrow. Under the influence of the associated northeast monsoon, temperatures over Guangdong will fall in the next couple of days. Meanwhile, upper-air disturbances will bring heavy showers and squally thunderstorms to the region. With the upper-air disturbances departing, the weather will improve slightly over the coast of Guangdong during the weekend to early next week. A trough of low pressure is expected to bring unsettled weather to southern China midweek next week.

Wind: South force 4 to 5, becoming northeast force 4.
Weather: Mainly cloudy with a few showers. Showers will increase gradually with a few squally thunderstorms during the day. Temperatures will fall progressively.
Temp range: 23 - 27 C
R.H. range: 75 - 95 per Cent
PSR: Medium High
